sources.snippet: NeuraChat is an AI-powered conversational system built using advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) like Ollama, TinyLLaMA, Mistral, DistilGPT-2, and Phi-2. The chatbot architecture is designed to be scalable and modular, using Flask microservices, PostgreSQL for structured data, and deployed on Virtual Machines (VMs) to simulate real-world environments.
